correctness.rationale: Rechecked the repaired theorem for each n=2m−1≡1 mod 4, n≥5. Closed neighborhoods of size four force at least m tokens. A constructed word with one adjacent same-row pair and an even number m−1 of color-reversing empty columns attains m. Two tokens in one column spend all excess coverage at once and forbid further tokens in the next two columns on either side. To cover column 2 then requires two more tokens sharing a column, or an already forbidden column for n=5. Thus each occupied column has one token. Each empty column needs opposite row colors in its flanks; the m versus m−1 column counts force exactly one adjacent pair, whose members have the same color. For each of its n positions there are two complementary colorings and a same-support swap cannot connect them. Removing a singleton outside the pair creates two empty–empty edges; filling another column cannot fix both. Removing a pair member forces filling the neighboring empty column, in the row opposite to the departing token. Only these two moves are possible; other empty flanks are unchanged. The left move acts on pair position/color by (i,x)→(i−2, complement x), visiting every column in n steps and reversing the color on return because n is odd. Its inverse is the right move and the orbit has length 2n. Hence there are no slides, and the jump graph is C_(2n), with radius and diameter n. This proof is all-length; the unchanged finite support includes n=5 and 9 checked directly.
residual_risks: The claim now excludes all other residues, larger sets and different move rules. The frozen finite diagnostics were inspected, not executed afresh.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The variable-capacity move theorem does not imply fixed-size exchanges. Knowing the count or overlap index does not establish adjacency and distance; even given the exact repaired state language, one must characterize support changes, force the destination row and establish the single orbit. The discrepancy at n=7 is a limitation of applying the inspected structural lemma outside the repaired class, not a refutation of the prior numerical count.

value.rationale: At minimum cardinality on a natural cubic family, every placement can be reached from every other with jumps, yet no minimum placement admits even one slide. The proof gives the exact movement cost and its dependence on the exceptional adjacent pair, not just a finite example, an optimum-state count, or a numerical flexibility proxy. This is a useful reconfiguration benchmark in the residue where independent domination does not apply.
residual_risks: The gain is a specific infinite-family exact benchmark, not a general reconfiguration theorem or a claim on the excluded congruence classes.
